items.title: Federal judge blocks Minnesota prediction market ban, finding state statute likely preempted by federal law
items.content_text: - **Federal judge blocks Minnesota prediction market ban, finding state statute likely preempted by federal law** — Judge Katherine Menendez granted preliminary injunctive relief, concluding Minnesota's prediction market statute is likely at least partially preempted because the CFTC has exclusive jurisdiction over swaps traded on designated contract markets. The ruling found Kalshi, Polymarket US and the CFTC faced threats of irreparable harm if the state enforced the ban. ([GambleRss](https://gamblerss.com/federal-judge-blocks-minnesota-s-proposed-prediction-markets-ban-66705))

items.content_text: - **Ohio orders 10 prediction market operators to stop sports contracts after Sixth Circuit win** — The Ohio Casino Control Commission sent cease-and-desist letters dated October 2 to Coinbase, Gemini Titan, Moomoo Financial, Novig, Plus500US, Polymarket, ProphetX, Robinhood Derivatives, Underdog and Webull Financial, ordering each to stop offering sports event contracts in Ohio and notify the commission in writing within 14 days.
